page_title: StudyArena: pick the best AI for your homework

sources.entry: StudyArena - Students compare three AI explanations for free, vote before seeing model names, then reveal which models answered. #freemium #education

summary.name: StudyArena
summary.one_liner: StudyArena is a free study tool that sends one homework question to three anonymous AI models (including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini) and lets you vote on the best answer before revealing which models wrote them.
use_cases: Getting homework explanations from several AI models at once
Comparing which AI model explains a math problem best
Checking writing feedback across different chatbots
Trying new AI models before paying for subscriptions
Grading papers with an AI as a teaching-assistant style reviewer
summary.what_it_does: StudyArena takes one question and returns answers from three models side by side, which the page says include ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Kimi. The model names are hidden while you read and vote for the best answer, and they are revealed afterward. Sign-in is required to ask a first question, with Google, Apple or email options. The page includes testimonials about comparing response variation and writing tasks, but these are anecdotal and not measured results. A Mac download link is shown.
notable: Blind side-by-side comparison of three anonymous AI models per question
Vote before model names are revealed
Access to multiple chat models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi) in one place
caveats: Requires creating an account (Google, Apple or email) to ask a question
Listing describes it as freemium; the page does not detail which features are paid
Available model list is only given as examples ('and more')
